summary: Feature request to expose non-deterministic random APIs for use in query plugins and interceptors, enabling generation of unique IDs for observability and telemetry purposes.
userImpact: Users cannot generate unique IDs for observability and telemetry in query plugins because named random streams are deterministically seeded from the workflow seed.
rootCause: Named random streams are seeded from the workflow seed by design to maintain determinism, preventing non-deterministic random generation.
proposedFix: Expose underlying non-deterministic random APIs and a named random stream seeded with nondeterministic randomness under `workflowInfo.unsafe`.
keyQuote: Expose underlying non-deterministic random APIs + a named random stream seeded with nondeterministic randomness under `workflowInfo.unsafe`
